readings: Link each budget line to its event (event.event_id = budget.link_to_event, exact text match; drop lines without a matching event), and keep only lines whose spent is more than 6.0. For each event status, show the status, the average over those lines of the per-line difference (amount - spent), ignoring lines where that difference is missing (blank if there are none), and the number of such budget lines. Leave the results unrounded.

Link each budget line to its event (event.event_id = budget.link_to_event, exact text match; drop lines without a matching event), and keep only lines whose spent is more than 6.0. For each event status, show the status, the average of amount minus the average of spent (each average computed separately over its own non-missing values, blank if there are none), and the number of such budget lines. Leave the results unrounded.
queries:
SELECT e.status, AVG(b.amount - b.spent), COUNT(*)
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.spent > 6.0
GROUP BY e.status

SELECT e.status,
       AVG(b.amount) - AVG(b.spent) AS diff,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.spent > 6.0
GROUP BY e.status
